texts: On day 33 of Year 1, a harvest party of twelve people left Aelmere at sundown.
Sailsworn led the harvest party along the goat-path to the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.
The harvest party carried copper buckets and wooden scrapers.
Coraline Ash walked with the harvest party.
Sailsworn assigned each member of the harvest party to one of the five blooming pools in the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.
Sailsworn assigned Coraline Ash to the second pool from the north.

parse: (: assign_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_party_1) (And (Member (sk_assign $x) assign) (Agent (sk_assign $x) sailsworn) (Theme (sk_assign $x) $x) (Goal (sk_assign $x) (sk_pool $x)) (Member (sk_pool $x) pool) (PartOf (sk_pool $x) sk_pools_1) (Past (sk_assign $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: copper is a noun modifier, so its genus must not be exposed (the explicit "steel_beam is not steel" rule, decided by part of speech); only a material adjective such as wooden earns the modifier genus.
"left Aelmere" has a bare direct object, which the role rules assign Theme (or Patient by the change test); Source is defined as the "from ..." oblique, not a direct-object role.
"along the goat-path" is not a via / by-way-of means phrase, so Instrument overreaches where the surface-preposition oblique — the preposition actually used — applies.

q2_gaps: a plural multi-word proper name whose head is a kind word ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the Kestrel River rule prescribes a type atom from a kind word inside the name, but its singular Member shape does not fit a named plural set and the "the Wrens" bullet bars a per-member kind from the label word, so the parse states nothing about what the place is

coordinated direct objects ("carried copper buckets and wooden scrapers"): the distributive-by-default coordination rule is written for coordinated subjects ("a shared object reuses one symbol"), leaving one event with two Theme atoms vs two replicated events undecided

an ordinal ranked along a stated spatial axis ("the second pool from the north"): Ordinal's scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension, not a compass-direction ordering
review.notes: The quantified sentence is handled well: the "each member of" universal ranges over PartOf with a per-binding Skolem pool for the dependent existential, the QuantifierPhrase companion names the collective kind, and "blooming" distributes to the pool group's members by rule rather than riding the group symbol. CoAgent for the comitative, GroupOf+Cardinality for the twelve-person party, and LocatedIn for the pools are all correct.

issues.reason: Compound concepts bars exposing a noun modifier's genus and says the line is "part of speech, not meaning" with the explicit steel_beam-is-not-steel case; copper is the same noun-before-noun as steel, and (Inheritance copper_bucket copper) additionally states the falsehood that a copper bucket is an instance of the metal.

The half that stands is that the direct-object mapping nominally sends a bare object to Theme and Source is glossed as the "from …" oblique; the half that falls is calling it a defect — Theme's own definition (acquired / transferred / moved / possessed / perceived / evaluated) does not fit a place departed from, the instruction set states no rule for a locative direct object, and (Source sk_leave_1 aelmere) is true of the sentence and well-typed.

Instrument's route licence is keyed to the wordings "via / by way of", while the oblique rule is mechanical — "the head is the preposition actually used — never a synonym head for a near-fit reading" and "decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest" — so the licensed head is the surface-preposition oblique, and Instrument over-asserts the path as the means of the leading.

gaps_confirmed: a plural multi-word proper name whose head is a kind word ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the Kestrel River rule licenses a type atom from a kind word inside the name, but its singular Member shape does not fit a named plural set and the "the Wrens" bullet bars GroupOf and a per-member kind from the label word, so the place's kind goes unstated

coordinated direct objects ("carried copper buckets and wooden scrapers"): the distributive-by-default coordination rule is illustrated only on subjects with a shared object, leaving one event with two Theme atoms vs two replicated events undecided

an ordinal ranked along a stated spatial axis ("the second pool from the north"): Ordinal's scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension, not a compass-direction ordering
new_gaps: a departure verb with a locative direct object ("left Aelmere"): the direct-object rule yields Theme, whose definition covers only things acquired / transferred / moved / possessed / perceived / evaluated, while Source and Goal are defined as PP obliques — nothing licenses "the place departed from" as a bare object, and a licensed form would need to carry the source-of-motion reading of a direct object without claiming the place moved

the QuantifierPhrase group-kind slot when a group carries both a collective noun and a member kind ("each member of the harvest party", with (Member sk_party_1 harvest_party) and (GroupOf sk_party_1 person)): "a group premise names the group kind" does not say whether the collective kind or the member kind fills the slot, so two faithful parses can differ
adjudication.defect_summary: For the modifier genus the compliant form is the head genus alone — (Inheritance copper_bucket bucket) with no (Inheritance copper_bucket copper), exactly as steel_beam gets no steel genus; for the route phrase the compliant form is the surface-preposition oblique (Along sk_lead_1 sk_path_1) in place of (Instrument sk_lead_1 sk_path_1).
adjudication.notes: Everything else holds: the each-of-the-party universal ranging over PartOf with a per-binding Skolem pool for the dependent existential, the blooming distribution rule instead of a property on the group symbol, CoAgent for the comitative, GroupOf + Cardinality on the twelve-person party, and the LocatedIn / Ordinal / bridging-PartOf improvisations for the tide-pools are all true and well-typed. "Left Aelmere" is the one place where the stated direct-object mapping and the role definitions genuinely pull apart.
